text:
Ravi: Quick one — Celeos (acct CE-77) says AE verbally promised an "intro lower tier" rate for months 1-3 during negotiation. They were billed full list on INV-CE-2026-11 for $24,000 and are asking for a retro credit of $7,200 (30% intro).

June: I can see an email from AE but no Deal Desk entry. CRM note: 'intro pricing 30% M1-M3 to win POC'. No signed amendment.

Carlos: Policy: pricing exceptions > $5k require Deal Desk + Finance lead. This is $7,200 so escalate. Need Sales Ops confirmation and GL mapping. Also want to know if this will be recurring or one-off.

Ravi: Customer says they expect the 30% for next two invoices as well. Sales Ops (Maya) — can you confirm AE commitment and advise whether we should honor for future invoices?

Maya: Confirmed AE verbally committed. Sales Ops recommends honoring the intro pricing for months 1-3 to avoid losing the POC. They want it applied to the next two billing cycles too. Recommend Deal Desk capture as 'intro concession; convert when MA signs'.

Carlos: If we apply to future invoices, that's effectively a pricing amendment and would need Sales Ops + Finance + Legal sign-off. If it's a one-time retro credit, Deal Desk + Finance lead is sufficient. Which does Sales want?

Maya: Sales wants it applied to M1-M3 (so retro credit for M1 plus two forward adjustments). We need Legal OK for a short-term pricing exception without MA.

Ravi: Support SR-9921 shows customer will pause deployment unless pricing honored. Churn risk high.

Carlos: OK — open Deal Desk DD-2026-998 with request: retro credit $7,200 + billing rule to apply 30% discount for next 2 invoices. GL for retro credit: 6510 (Customer Discounts). For forecast/recognition, Sales Ops to flag month close. Legal to review wording.

Maya: DD-2026-998 created and tagged to Legal. Draft memo: 'one-time intro pricing concession for CE-77, retro credit $7,200, apply 30% discount on next two invoices; classify retro credit as GL 6510.'

Legal (via note): verbal commitments are non-binding; legal approves temporary commercial concession on condition Deal Desk documents timeframe and that no master agreement prices are changed.

Carlos: Finance lead approves retro credit $7,200 and forward discount for two invoices as a documented exception. Conditions: record Deal Desk ID DD-2026-998, GL 6510 for retro credit, document in AR, and require AE to log MA follow-up.

Ravi: Great. BillingBot, queue credit memo CM-CE-2026-11-33 for INV-CE-2026-11 amount=7200 reason='intro pricing concession (AE commitment)'. Also please create a billing schedule rule to apply 30% discount to next two invoices for account CE-77.

BillingBot: queued credit memo CM-CE-2026-11-33 (amount: $7,200) for INV-CE-2026-11. Created billing rule BR-CE-2026-77 to apply 30% discount for next 2 invoices. ETA: 24h to post. Reference: #CM-CE-2026-11-33, #BR-CE-2026-77.

Maya: I'll update Deal Desk with GL 6510 and note Sales Ops will book contra-revenue in month close. Also instruct AE to get MA signature.

BillingBot: CM-CE-2026-11-33 posted to customer account at 2026-11-14T13:05:09Z. Billing rule BR-CE-2026-77 active for invoices dated up to 2027-01-15.

Ravi: Confirmed customer notified and happy. PS will monitor POC progress. Closing DD-2026-998 after AE provides MA follow-up. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
